road_trip:
ROAD TRIP HIGHWAY CORRIDOR & DEFAULT ROUND-TRIP REQUIREMENT:
- DEFAULT ROUND TRIP: Every road trip is a ROUND TRIP starting from {origin} and returning to {origin} on Day {duration} unless the user explicitly requested 'one-way'.
- OUTBOUND & WAYPOINTS (Days 1 to {duration_minus_1}): Construct the driving journey from {origin} toward {destination} with authentic highway stops, state/national parks, roadside diners, and intermediate overnight stays in waypoint towns.
- FINAL DAY RETURN (Day {duration}): The final day MUST be the return driving journey back to {origin} (e.g. {destination} -> Highway Waypoints -> {origin}), with lunch at 12:00 PM, return highway drive arriving back in {origin} by 05:30 PM for rental vehicle return, and concluding with dinner in {origin}.
- Set 'travel_mode': 'drive' for all driving legs. Package tiers are: 'budget' (Budget Saver), 'balanced' (Balanced Choice), and 'luxury' (Signature Luxury VIP).
flight_vacation:
FLIGHT VACATION LOGISTICS:
This is a flight-based vacation from {origin} to {destination}. Default is round-trip flight. Structure activities around flight arrival logistics on Day 1, central hotel check-in, iconic city sightseeing, and departure wrap-up on Day {duration}. Package tiers are: 'budget' (Budget Saver), 'balanced' (Balanced Choice), and 'luxury' (Signature Luxury VIP).
cruise:
CRUISE & MARITIME VOYAGE LOGISTICS:
This is an Ocean/River Cruise departing from {origin} to {destination}. Day 1: Port embarkation, ship check-in, and scenic sail-away viewing. Days 2 to {duration_minus_1}: Daily ports-of-call, shore excursions, coastal promenade walks, harbor dining, and maritime activities with 'travel_mode': 'boat' or 'ferry'. Final Day: Return port debarkation and departure.
fly_and_drive:
FLY & DRIVE COMBINATION LOGISTICS:
This is a Fly-and-Drive journey from {origin} to {destination}. Fly into {destination}, pick up rental car at the airport, and embark on scenic regional road trips and day excursions across the surrounding region before returning to the hub.
